_about: This machine's agent identity. One per machine, kept out of git (agent.example.json is the template). The shared docs call the operations-manager role 'Nova'; the agent reads that as itself.
name: <Agent name, e.g. Mars>
photo: <path to this agent's photo inside the folder>
atlas_permission_mode: <empty = Atlas uses the allowed-tools list (Claude app); bypassPermissions = the main session runs in bypass (terminal)>
tracking: <base = the shared Lark Base task tracker (default); local = this machine's old register>
